summary: The forecast decision stays held. On 2024-25 GW10, score_xp and scraped xP correlate at Spearman +0.72 with a unique player-fixture key and no sign flip. The 20-week log-score test detects 0.010 at 80% power (null half-width 0.0055). The decision replay on score_xp gives greedy minus hold +7.36 [+4.50, +10.04] points per gameweek. That rule is not the published hold of 1.25. No winner versus ep_next. The hit threshold +4.33 was not applied. Chips did not fire. Live pre-deadline weeks: 0.
